value.rationale: The problem is motivated by the initiating paper’s numerically unresolved change between continuous and discontinuous SIS onsets under degree correlation. The exact rational degeneracy curve across all irreducible assortativities and the strict monotonicity are a natural complete parameter classification of the onset mechanism. The strictly negative model-specific cubic yields a sharp, physical-time critical infected-fraction relaxation vector. This provides a reusable quantitative benchmark for network-structure sensitivity and is more than a routine textbook result or arbitrary numerical improvement.
